species.real: Britain's two commonest pipistrelles were only recognised as separate species in the 1990s, after bat detectors showed one calls at about 45 kHz and the other at about 55 kHz.
species.name: Flittermouse

dex.text: Flutters past your head at dusk, close enough to tickle your ear and fast enough to be gone. Eats midges by the thousand.
dex.fact: Common pipistrelles are among Britain's smallest bats, and one can weigh less than a pound coin.
